title: Pepper's Ghost pyramid
blurb: One live interactive HTML telemetry card driving both an orbitable 3D virtual acrylic pyramid chamber with a clickable floating hologram and a pitch-black 4-way smartphone Pepper's Ghost projector on one WebGL 2 canvas.
question: Can one live interactive HTML telemetry card drive both a real 4-way smartphone Pepper's Ghost acrylic pyramid projection and an orbitable 3D virtual glass pyramid chamber where the floating translucent hologram stays clickable and editable?
result: Not verified in a live browser yet. One ElementGL WebGL 2 context uploads the glowing transparent HTML card with texElementSubImage2D(), renders both a 3D 45-degree acrylic pyramid chamber (with four floor projections and a floating translucent hologram) and a pitch-black 4-quadrant DIY smartphone projector, and keeps buttons and the text input interactive through projective and pointer-following updateElementGeometry().
